---
title: "Main Figure 1: experimental setup and integrated workflow"
format: html
editor: source
---

Layout-only promotion of reviewed SVG sources. SVG panels are rendered separately
to isolate their CSS definitions. Routes and stations are retained unchanged.
The final PDF is a high-resolution raster review composite; original vector SVG
panels are retained alongside it for final journal production. No models are run.

```{r}
out <- commandArgs(TRUE)[[1]]
stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
dir.create(out, recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(out,"sources"))
src <- "manuscript/figure_sources"
files <- c("experimental_setup_reactor.svg", "experimental_setup_cleaning-event.svg",
 "experimental_setup_sampling-design.svg", "experimental_setup_tmp.svg", "workflow_metro.svg")
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
 d <- xml2::read_xml(file.path(src,files[i]))
 ns <- c(s="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg")
 for (n in xml2::xml_find_all(d,"//s:text/text() | //s:tspan/text()",ns)) {
  xml2::xml_set_text(n,gsub("Phage-UV","Treatment",xml2::xml_text(n),fixed=TRUE))
 }
 if (i == 1) {
  # Remove long caption-like notes, which previously overran the adjacent panel.
  txt <- xml2::xml_find_all(d,"//s:text",ns)
  drop <- grepl("retentate returns|blue: quartz|black: membrane|Each membrane is cleaned",xml2::xml_text(txt))
  xml2::xml_remove(txt[drop])
  n <- xml2::xml_find_first(d,"//s:text[contains(.,'FOULING TRIGGER')]",ns)
  xml2::xml_set_text(n,"Cleaning trigger: TMP 40-50 kPa")
 }
 if (i == 2) {
  n <- xml2::xml_find_first(d,"//s:g[@id='sample-backflush']/s:circle",ns)
  xml2::xml_set_name(n,"path")
  xml2::xml_set_attrs(n,c(class="dot",d="M1474,289 L1484,308 L1464,308 Z"))
 }
 if (i == 4) {
  xml2::xml_remove(xml2::xml_find_all(d,"//s:text",ns))
  xml2::xml_set_attr(xml2::xml_root(d),"viewBox","830 540 710 440")
 }
 if (i == 5) {
  xml2::xml_remove(xml2::xml_find_all(d,"//s:g[@id='legend-notes']",ns))
  n <- xml2::xml_find_first(d,"//s:text[contains(.,'terminus') and contains(.,'positive')]",ns)
  xml2::xml_set_text(n,"terminus - analysis output")
 }
 xml2::write_xml(d,file.path(out,"sources",files[i]))
}
layout <- data.frame(file=files,x=c(30,900,30,910,20),y=c(55,55,550,550,1250),
 w=c(830,1070,840,1070,1960),h=c(311,447,374,663,1130),letter=LETTERS[1:5])
# PNG preview uses librsvg through sharp; no browser or headless browser involved.
sharp <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/sharp"
js <- c(sprintf("const sharp=require('%s');",sharp),"(async()=>{const layers=[];")
for (i in 1:5) {
 p <- normalizePath(file.path(out,"sources",files[i]))
 js <- c(js,sprintf("layers.push({input:await sharp('%s',{density:144}).resize(%d,%d).png().toBuffer(),left:%d,top:%d});",
 p,layout$w[i],layout$h[i],layout$x[i],layout$y[i]))
}
labels <- paste(sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%d">%s</text>',layout$x,layout$y-18,layout$letter),collapse="")
js <- c(js,sprintf("layers.push({input:Buffer.from('<svg width=\"2000\" height=\"2390\"><g font-family=\"Arial\" font-size=\"24\">%s</g></svg>'),left:0,top:0});",labels),
 sprintf("await sharp({create:{width:2000,height:2390,channels:4,background:'white'}}).composite(layers).png().toFile('%s/preview.png');})();",normalizePath(out)))
tmp <- tempfile(fileext=".js"); writeLines(js,tmp)
stopifnot(system2("node",tmp)==0)
unlink(tmp)
im <- png::readPNG(file.path(out,"preview.png"))
grDevices::pdf(file.path(out,"figure1-experimental-workflow.pdf"),width=8,height=9.56)
grid::grid.raster(im); grDevices::dev.off()
write.table(data.frame(file=files,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(src,files)))),
 file.path(out,"input_checksums.tsv"),sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE)
writeLines(c("Layout only; no scientific calculations rerun.",
 "All original metro routes/stations retained; standalone CSS rendering prevents label clashes.",
 "Treatment terminology replaces Phage-UV. TMP poster raster retained and identified in caption.",
 "PDF is raster review composite at 250 dpi; source SVG panels retained for production.",
 "Aligned sampling-TMP candidate not adopted because its review is pending.",
 "Modelling terminal not added: existing route records stop at community, edgeR and host context."),file.path(out,"VALIDATION.txt"))
```
